title: Lekalo Laravel Migration Input
description: Closed independent contract for the bounded Laravel migration input document (issue #57). Core renders it from one gated engine migration plan plus its optional validated rename history and typed rollback classification; the PHP adapter consumes exactly this document to emit deterministic Laravel migration artifacts and never re-derives SQL. The effective gate unions destructive and backfill_required risks: a document whose effectiveStatus is blocked never generates bytes. The document is pure data - no credentials, hosts, URLs, users, wall-clock timestamps, or provider output.

baseDigest.description: The canonical digest of the base storage-projection attachment.

candidateDigest.description: The canonical digest of the candidate storage-projection attachment.

diffDigest.description: The digest binding the consumed plan to the exact semantic diff it was derived from.

historyDigest.description: The canonical digest of the validated storage-rename-history document the plan consumed, when one was declared.

planId.description: The exact plan identity of the consumed engine plan; the confirmation handle a caller must have named for a gated plan.

gated.description: Whether the plan carries destructive steps.

backfillGated.description: Whether the plan carries backfill obligations; the Laravel generation policy gates them like destructive rewrites.

effectiveStatus.description: The closed custody verdict after the effective gate: ready applies, blocked writes zero bytes until the exact planId is confirmed, confirmed names it.

operations.description: The ordered plan operations with their typed rollback classification.

risk.description: The closed data risk of one operation, spelled exactly as the storage-projection DataRisk.

rollbackClass.description: The closed rollback classification: reversible restores the schema exactly, data-loss-on-rollback drops rows created since, irreversible has no faithful inverse and refuses down().

ordinal.description: The 1-based ordinal of this operation in the plan's dependency order.

kind.description: The closed step-kind vocabulary of the engine plan v1.

statement.description: The deterministic SQL text of the operation; identifiers are always quoted.

requires.description: The ordinals this operation depends on, in ascending order.

inverse.description: The rendered inverse statement, present only when the rollback is reversible and fully determined by typed metadata.
